title: Forge — Audit
_comment: Audit: session outcome rollup, PR-merge rate, no-change rate (docs/14 §6). Queryable copy of the R2 WORM audit (docs/12 §4) via Pipelines → ClickHouse.

list.name: repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repo_id FROM forge.session_event ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Session outcome rollup
panels._comment: The 5 terminal outcomes (merged/closed/no_change/failed/cancelled — docs/11 §2). From session_outcome_daily MV (docs/12 §5).

targets.query: SELECT outcome, sum(session_count) AS c FROM forge.session_outcome_daily_table WHERE toDate(ended_at) > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY c DESC

panels.title: PR-merge rate (session → merged PR conversion)
panels._comment: The PRD's leading indicator: session→PR conversion (>35% target, docs/01 §3).

targets.query: SELECT sumIf(session_count, outcome = 'merged') / sum(session_count) AS merge_rate FROM forge.session_outcome_daily_table WHERE toDate(ended_at) > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo)

panels.title: No-change rate (agent ran, decided nothing needed changing)
panels._comment: Valid outcome (docs/11 §2) but a high rate signals the classifier or prompt quality issue.

targets.query: SELECT sumIf(session_count, outcome = 'no_change') / sum(session_count) AS no_change_rate FROM forge.session_outcome_daily_table WHERE toDate(ended_at) > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo)

SELECT toDate(ended_at) AS d, repo_id, outcome, sum(session_count) AS c FROM forge.session_outcome_daily_table WHERE toDate(ended_at) > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY d, repo_id, outcome ORDER BY d

panels.title: Cost per merged PR by repo (efficiency ranking)
panels._comment: The data-flywheel's key query (docs/01 §3): avg LLM spend per successful merged PR by repo.

targets.query: SELECT repo_id, avg(total_cost) AS cost_per_merged FROM forge.session_outcome_daily_table WHERE outcome = 'merged' AND toDate(ended_at) > $__timeFrom AND repo_id IN ($repo) GROUP BY repo_id ORDER BY cost_per_merged DESC
